test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

This monument is the older building in this area.
solution: The erroneous part is **'is the older building'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'is the oldest building'** should be used instead of** 'is the older building'.** • We know that after a definite article '**the**', **superlative degree** is used. • *Example: Marcus is the **tallest** boy in the class. * • Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**. **Correct Sentence:__** *This monument is the **oldest** building in this area.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ **'is the older building'** के स्थान पर **'is the oldest building' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि एक निश्चित article '**the**' के बाद **superlative degree** का प्रयोग किया जाता है। • *Example: Marcus is the **tallest** boy in the class. * अत: सही उत्तर** विकल्प 3** है। 37:Tc37, The correct answer is '**suggest**'.
